scope: Warlord modular atlas — first local candidate
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent modular sprite atlas, NOT a concept painting. Create ONE PNG, 5 equal columns by 4 equal rows, exactly 20 fully separate isolated architecture components with broad transparent gutters. No labels or drawn grid. Each cell has one complete cutout; nothing cut by cell edges. Transparent background, no landscape, water, sky, scenery, floor plates, diamond bases or vignette. Consistent distant three-quarter overhead camera seen from the south, roofs and upper surfaces clearly visible, light upper left. All pieces belong to ONE coherent small-building-scale tileset for an illustrated regional game map.

Identity: the Warlord enemy class, an oppressive inhabited armoured god-city, Unbending Crown grammar: rigid upright spear-prongs bound by a horizontal closed band. Weathered charcoal masonry, vermilion/brick-red roofs and cloth, oxidized teal metal straps, subdued old bone structural supports. Ossified ribs and spines physically brace halls and arcades, not decorative skull piles. No faces, skull faces, eyes, wounds or gore; no people. Decay secondary to imposing useful architecture. Architectural modules need believable doors/windows matching ordinary small houses; grandeur comes when many pieces combine, never gigantic doors or overscaled houses. The keep is a compact part of a larger composition, NOT a whole city or enormous painting. No giant crest pasted on roofs. Shared pixel-cluster surface, hard deliberate edges, selective hatching/dithering, restricted local material colours. Broad middle values make buildings readable on warm ochre/olive terrain; do not crush everything black or add gold glows. Palette on actual roof/metal surfaces, no overall colour filter.

Exact row-major cells:
Row 1: compact three-prong citadel gate tower with binding teal band, only one civic building; long low red-roof barracks wing; compact armoury with rib-braced gable; narrow rib-vaulted arcade; squat square fortified tower.
Row 2: low straight wall section running northeast/southwest; matching low straight wall northwest/southeast; convex wall corner with small buttress; small inhabited gate arch with red lintel cloth and teal fittings; ruined gate arch with broken spear-like uprights.
Row 3: L-shaped low civic courtyard wing (empty courtyard remains transparent); straight roofed colonnade wing; ruined barracks wing with partial collapsed red roof; broken low wall with exposed ossified structural spine; small group of two ruined house shells.
Row 4: one ordinary narrow red-roof stone house; pair of ordinary red-roof houses; compact workshop shed; low crumbled foundation fragment; one small independent red pennant on a short teal standard.
Keep every piece separate, with intact complete silhouettes and generous alpha margin. No rounded scenic grounds under buildings. Low rubbly feet can fade into true alpha. Roofs, doors and stone grain have the SAME architectural scale across all cells, even when footprints differ. This is a composable map asset sheet, not cards, not a city-sized illustration, not a glossy 3D asset.
